questions.q: This program ___ us with our work.
questions.e: 说程序的用途，用一般现在时。program 是单数，help 要加 s。

questions.q: The earth ___ around the sun.
questions.e: 地球绕太阳转是事实，用一般现在时。earth 是单数，go 要变 goes。

questions.q: I go shopping ___. I only go on Saturdays and Sundays.
questions.e: 只在周六和周日购物，所以用 on weekends，周五和周一不算周末。

questions.q: Our parents ___ the same show together.
questions.e: often 放在 watch 前。主语是复数，watch 不加 es。

questions.q: The center ___ busy on weekends.
questions.e: center 是单数，用 is 接 busy，usually 放在 is 后。

questions.q: I can ___ what she says. She speaks very fast.
questions.e: never 紧跟 can，understand 用原形，不加 s 或 ing。

questions.q: My day at work ___ (end) at six, but my bus comes at seven.
a: ends
questions.e: 下班和班车时间是固定的，用一般现在时。主语是单数 my day，end 末尾要加 s。

questions.q: The bus ___ (be / always) on time, so I take it to work.
a: is always
questions.e: 主语 the bus 是单数，用 is。always 这类频率副词放在 be 动词后面，所以是 is always，不是 always is。

questions.zh: 我父亲每天工作八小时。
a: My father works eight hours every day.
My father works for eight hours every day.
questions.e: 每天工作是习惯，my father 是第三人称单数，要用 works。时长 eight hours 前可以加 for。

a: I sometimes go shopping by myself.
Sometimes I go shopping by myself.
questions.e: sometimes 可放在句首或 go 前。go shopping 是完整搭配，别把 sometimes 插在这两个词中间。
先说主语 our team，再用 is 连接形容词 ready。普通陈述句里，always 放在 is 后。

questions.a: My friend and I take the same bus to work every morning.
questions.e: every morning 表示每天早上的习惯。my friend and I 是两个人，take 不加 s。

questions.q: Does your school ___ students to use their phones in class?
questions.e: Does 已标出三单，主语后的 allow 用原形，不再加 s。

questions.q: My parents ___ much money on games. They usually play the same game.
questions.e: 主语是复数，用 don't 加原形。aren't 不能接 spend。

questions.q: The door is open, but the students ___ in the room. They are at home.
questions.e: 用 be 说明位置，主语是复数，用 aren't，不能用 don't。

questions.q: Is your new job hard? — Yes, ___.
questions.e: Is 开头用 is 回答。肯定简答末尾的 it is 不能缩成 it's。

questions.q: Do you and your sister use the same phone? — Yes, ___.
questions.e: 问句用 Do，简答也用 do。两人用 we，不能用 does。

questions.q: Can you ___ a little water to my coffee?
questions.e: 往咖啡里加水，用 add A to B。spend 用于花费时间或钱。

questions.q: We live near our school. We ___ (not need) a car.
a: don't need
do not need
questions.e: need 是实义动词，主语 we 用 do not 或 don't，后面接原形 need。

questions.q: Are these your books? — No, they ___. They are my sister's.
a: aren't
are not
questions.e: Are 开头的问句用 are 作答。否定直接加 not，不换成 don't。

a: We don't work from home.
We do not work from home.
We don't work at home.
questions.e: work 是实义动词，否定用 don't 或 do not，后面接原形。不能用 aren't work。

a: This information isn't important.
This information is not important.
questions.e: important 是形容词，用 be 连接主语。information 不可数，所以用 this 和 is，不用 these 和 are。
open 在这里是形容词。主语 both doors 是复数，把 are 提到句首提问，不能用 do。

questions.a: My sister doesn't spend much time at home.
questions.e: my sister 是第三人称单数，否定用 doesn't，spend 保持原形。much time 指很多时间，time 不加 s。

questions.q: Can I call you later? I ___ to a student at the moment.
questions.e: 说此刻正在交谈，用 am talking。talk 是原形，不能直接跟 am。

questions.q: I ___ new words in my book every week, and I read them again on Sundays.
questions.e: every week 表示习惯，I 后用动词原形，不能加 s。

questions.q: The book is mine. It ___ to me.
questions.e: belong 表示归属，用一般现在时。主语 it 是三单，动词加 s。

questions.q: We only have ten minutes. We ___ more time.
questions.e: need 表示需要，描述状态。we 后用原形，不能加 are。

questions.q: My parents ___ this place. They want to live here.
questions.e: love 表示喜爱，用一般现在时。parents 是复数，动词不加 s。

questions.q: Their children are ___ fast.
questions.e: 孩子正在长大，are 后接 growing。原形 grow 不能直接跟 are。

questions.q: Please be quiet. I ___ (read) an email at the moment.
a: am reading
questions.e: at the moment 指此刻，I 后用 am reading。单写 reading 会漏掉 am，写 read 则成了一般现在时。

questions.q: I ___ (want) to see the results now.
a: want
questions.e: want 表示愿望，是状态动词。now 说明现在就想看，也用 want，不用 am wanting。

a: The teacher is working at home this week.
The teacher is working from home this week.
This week, the teacher is working at home.
questions.e: 这周在家工作是暂时的安排，用 is working。别在 is 后直接写原形 work。

a: I have both books.
I have both of the books.
questions.e: have 在这里表示拥有，用一般现在时。both 后的 books 用复数，写 am having 会误把拥有当作动作。

questions.a: The students are talking about the party.
questions.zh: 学生们正在谈论那场聚会。
questions.e: students 是复数，正在谈论要用 are talking。谈论的内容放在 about 后，不能写成 talk to the party。

questions.a: I like this book, but my brother likes the other one.
questions.e: like 表示喜好，两处都用一般现在时。I 后用 like，my brother 是三单，要听出 likes 的词尾。

questions.q: ___ two teachers at the door. Can you go and talk to them?
questions.e: 说门口有人用 There be。two teachers 是复数，用 are。

questions.q: On the left, ___ a low table for the children.
questions.e: 说左边有什么，用 there be。a low table 是单数，用 is。

questions.q: We need to go shopping. There ___ any food at home.
questions.e: food 在这里不可数，用 isn't。说家里没有食物用 there be。

questions.q: Next to the door, there ___ two chairs and a small table.
questions.e: 离空最近的是复数 two chairs，用 are，别看最后的单数名词。

questions.q: ___ any buses now? I need to get home.
questions.e: 问现在有没有公交车，把 be 提前。buses 是复数，用 Are。

questions.q: The teacher ___ two books with her. We can look at them now.
questions.e: 说老师随身带着书，用 have；主语是单数，变成 has。

questions.q: Is there a phone in the office? — Yes, there ___.
a: is
questions.e: 问句用 Is there，肯定简答用 there is。a phone 是单数，不能用 are。

questions.q: There ___ (be) some bread and two cups of coffee in the kitchen.
a: is
questions.e: be 跟紧接着的 some bread 一致。bread 不可数，后面即使有 two cups，也用 is。

a: There aren't many people here today.
There are not many people here today.
There aren't a lot of people here today.
questions.e: 说这里人不多，用 there aren't many。people 是复数，不能用 isn't；aren't any 会变成一个人都没有。

a: There is still some food in the car.
There's still some food in the car.
questions.e: 说车里有什么，用 there be。some food 是不可数的量，所以用 is，still 放在 is 后表示还有。

questions.a: Is there enough room for all of us?
questions.zh: 有足够的空间容纳我们所有人吗？
questions.e: room 在这里是不可数的空间，用 is。问有没有，把 is 提到 there 前，不能用 Are there。

questions.a: There are some children in front of the school.
questions.e: 听到 children 要想到它是 child 的复数，存在句用 There are。in front of 表示在前面，介词 of 也要写。

questions.q: What ___ reading at the moment?
questions.e: 问正在读什么，把 are 提到复数主语前，不能用 do。

questions.q: Why ___ so much time at the office? — It's part of her job.
questions.e: Why 后把 does 提到 she 前，spend 用原形，不加 s。

questions.q: ___ the door for the students every morning? — Our teacher does.
questions.e: Who 本身是主语，直接接 opens。does 和 opens 不能一起用。

questions.q: ___ is this book? — It's five dollars.
questions.e: 回答是五美元，用 How much 问价。How old 问年纪。

questions.q: How ___ do you go home for lunch? — Once a week, on Fridays.
questions.e: 每周一次是频率，用 How often。How long 问时长。

questions.q: How ___ is your office from here? — It's just across the street.
questions.e: 就在街对面，回答的是距离，用 How far。How often 问频率。

questions.q: Which bus ___ (do) your father take to work?
a: does
questions.e: Which bus 问坐哪趟车。助动词放在主语 your father 前，并用三单 does，take 保持原形。

questions.q: How ___ is your brother? — He's ten years old.
a: old
questions.e: ten years old 是年龄，用 How old。How long 问持续了多长时间。

a: What are you looking for now?
What are you looking for right now?
What are you trying to find now?
questions.e: 问正在找什么，What 后把 are 提到 you 前。用 look for 时，不能漏掉 for。

a: How many people does your team need?
How many people do you need on your team?
questions.e: people 是可数复数，用 How many。助动词跟主语走，your team 配 does，you 配 do。

questions.a: How long do you usually stay there?
questions.e: 问每次待多长时间用 How long，后面接 do you，再把 usually 放在 stay 前。How often 会变成问频率。

questions.a: What time do your parents usually have breakfast?
questions.e: What time 问几点，后接 do 和复数主语 your parents。usually 放在 have 前，breakfast 前不加冠词。
